title: בנימין גנוביא

paragraphs: Binyamin Genuvya, his name, ruled in Rav’s name permitting intercourse with a virgin on Shabbat. Shmuel took offense; Binyamin died. “Blessed is God who killed him”; of Rav, “No harm befalls the righteous,” Jerusalem Berakhot 2, mishnah 6. Bavli Niddah 65a (cited here as 61a): Minyamin Saksena'ah; see there.
